name: MCU Prep: Black Panther (2018)
description: T'Challa isn't just a king, he's the guardian of a hidden nation wrestling with its place in the world, and rivals challenge his right to rule. See Wakanda's isolationist legacy clash with global responsibility and watch T'Challa's rule get tested by politics as much as by claws.
sourceOrigin: Selected by raymond-nassar for MCU Prep
